comments.value: Under further investigation, the OnDeserialization() method is still being called, however, any synced variables retain their local values and not the values set by the object owner.

Affected World is here https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_e529e0bc-15f7-47a7-89dc-f976644f8cbb
The world has debug cubes behind spawn that light green if syncing and red is if not.
There is a random chance that a non-master player joining this world will see these as red and the above log spam

details:
Apon joining a world with Udon behaviours using synced variables, there is a random chance that a behaviour will fail to synchronise
The affected user can rejoin the instance until those behaviours sync correctly (usually takes just 1 attempt)
This issue does not affect everyone, as most can join and have the instance sync correctly.
This is logged on the receiving side
